answer: Assembling that for 119 aliases means 119 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each vertex escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the tundra ledger records every share and the pearl audit publishes the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
